title: Psychology
tagline: Understand how people think, feel, and behave, and learn to study it scientifically.
overview:
The Certificate in Psychology is a three-year course of study in the scientific study of the mind and behavior. You begin with a broad introduction to the field and the statistics every psychologist relies on, then build the research skills to design, run, and interpret studies of your own.

Across the core you study development, social, cognitive, biological, clinical, and organizational psychology. In your final year you choose a concentration in clinical and counseling psychology, brain and cognition, or applied and social psychology, and complete a two-term senior sequence in which you propose, conduct, and report an original study.
outcomes: Describe the major concepts, theories, and findings across the core areas of psychology.
Design and critique research using appropriate methods, measures, and ethical safeguards.
Analyze and interpret behavioral data using descriptive and inferential statistics.
Apply psychological principles to personal, social, and organizational problems.
Communicate psychological knowledge clearly in writing, following APA conventions.
Recognize the role of culture and diversity in human behavior and psychological science.
